department: Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences

deadline.value: Apply by January 1 (2027) for highest consideration for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: Applications submitted by January 1st are given highest consideration for Fall semester admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is optional; send it only if it adds evidence.
gre_general.quote: the GRE general test is not required (optional).

supervisor.value: You must have an advisor identified before admission; international students are generally admitted only once an advisor and funding are found, so contact faculty early.
supervisor.quote: PhD students must have an advisor before they can be recommended for admission. | International students are generally only admitted once an advisor and funding source are identified.

funding.value: Admission does not guarantee funding; fewer than 10 students are funded most years, with RAs decided by faculty with grants.
funding.quote: An offer of admission for fall, typically made in February or early March, does not guarantee funding. | We can only offer funding to less than 10 in most years.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to start the PhD.
entry_route.quote: a master’s degree is not required to start a Ph.D. program.
